name: Vampire - Charm - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a action

results.text: The target shudders violently, snapping out of the trance with a gasp of defiance.
Their eyes narrow in sudden clarity, the enchantment shattered by an iron will.
A sharp cry escapes them as they break free from the vampire’s hypnotic grasp.
With a growl, they shake off the spell, their expression twisting into fury.
The charm fizzles like mist before fire, their resolve unbroken.
